dossier.summary: Brightwell's plan appeals unit decides only appealed claims and may request provider records.

facts.statement: Appeals reviews a decision within the plan's time limit and may reverse an incorrect paid line.
facts.quote: A participant may appeal a claims or supervisor decision within 60 days. Appeals requests the provider register and decides within 15 business days. The decision is final. A paid line is reversed only when an appeal finds its dates incorrect.
